name: Federated Hermes, Inc.
reason: Money-market-heavy asset manager whose fees track short rates and fund flows (capital-markets/rate driven), with adjusted EPS of 5.13 at 1.0x its 10y high after a 59% jump in 2025; cheap at 9.6x but not a forecastable special business.

name: Steel Dynamics, Inc.
reason: Low-cost EAF steelmaker but earnings are set by steel spreads (EPS swung 2.84 -> 22.68 -> 7.99 and EBIT margin 4.5%-23.5% over 10y) plus a new aluminum mill; commodity-priced earnings fail the forecastability test.

name: Bristol-Myers Squibb Company
reason: Faces a credible patent cliff within 5 years (Eliquis, Opdivo, Pomalyst LOEs) with consensus FY3 EPS -19% and LTG -2.9%, after acquisition-driven growth (acq/FCF 0.74, shares +2%/yr) and large GAAP charges (adj vs GAAP gap 119%).

name: Wells Fargo & Company
reason: Huge diversified bank in a post-asset-cap restructuring; adjusted EPS only +4.2%/yr over 10y with 9.7% avg ROE and EPS now at 1.0x 10y high on rates and buybacks, so the 5-10y path depends on rate/credit cycles and execution we cannot forecast confidently.

name: Kohl's Corporation
reason: Structurally declining department store: revenue -2.1%/yr and adjusted EPS -8.7%/yr over 10y, EBIT margin 3.3% vs 8.6% peak, net debt/EBITDA 4.9x; no moat and balance sheet weak for a recession.

name: FMC Corporation
reason: Ag-chemicals maker facing generic diamide erosion and channel destocking: EBIT margin collapsed to 6.5% (9th pctile), adjusted EPS 0.40x 10y high, net debt/EBITDA 7.3x; fails balance sheet and forecastability tests.

name: 1st Source Corporation
reason: Conservatively run, family-controlled Indiana bank with niche specialty equipment finance, compounding adjusted EPS 11.4%/yr over 10y (15.1%/yr over 5y) with worst year only -11% (2020), no acquisitions and a flat share count; caveat is EPS at 1.0x 10y high and consensus FY2-FY3 growth of only 2-3%.

name: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc.
reason: Acquisition-built tools group (acq/FCF 1.2x over 10y) whose adjusted EPS fell from 10.48 (2021) to 4.67 with EBIT margin 8.2% vs 14.8% and net debt/EBITDA 3.45x in a cyclical, tariff-exposed business; fails the core-growth and balance-sheet tests.

name: Capital One Financial Corp
reason: Card/consumer lender whose earnings are set by the consumer credit cycle (EPS 5.71 in 2020 vs 27.11 in 2021) and that has just been transformed by the Discover acquisition (adj vs GAAP gap 82%), so 5-10y earnings cannot be forecast with confidence.

name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
reason: Excellent net-cash R&D franchise (10y ROIC 23%) but EPS is 0.59x its 2021 peak with EBIT margin at 9th pctile as Eylea loses share to biosimilars, leaving earnings dependent on Dupixent and binary pipeline outcomes (LTG 3.2%).

name: ArcBest Corporation
reason: Unionized LTL carrier with freight-cycle-driven earnings (EPS 13.66 in 2022 vs 3.70 in 2025, EBIT margin 1.5%-7.6%) and 10y ROIC 9%; cyclical and not special.

name: Progressive Corporation
reason: Best-in-class, data-driven auto underwriter with a long record of disciplined combined ratios, compounding adjusted EPS 24.5%/yr over 10y with 25% avg ROE and no acquisitions; caveat is EPS 18.06 at 1.0x 10y high on peak auto underwriting margins with consensus FY2 -12%, so deep analysis must normalize margins.

name: Align Technology, Inc.
reason: Dominant clear-aligner brand with net cash and 25% avg ROIC, but revenue has stalled since 2021, EBIT margin 17.1% vs 24.7% peak, and low-cost aligner competition plus discretionary consumer demand make 5-10y volume and pricing hard to forecast.

name: Blackstone Mortgage Trust, Inc.
reason: Levered commercial-real-estate mortgage REIT (net debt/EBITDA 12.4x) whose earnings are set by CRE credit and rates, with GAAP losses in 2024-25 (EPS -0.03, -1.43) and shares +7.7%/yr; fails credit-cycle and balance-sheet tests.

name: Ryder System, Inc.
reason: Capital-intensive truck leasing and logistics with negative 10y FCF conversion (-0.89), 4.7% avg ROIC and used-truck-price-driven earnings (EPS -0.27 in 2020 vs 16.37 in 2022), EBIT margin at 10y high; cyclical and not special.

name: SkyWest, Inc
reason: Regional airline dependent on a handful of major-airline capacity purchase contracts (single-customer-type risk) with EPS 10.35 at 1.0x 10y high and EBIT margin at 91st pctile after a sharp rebound, 4% avg ROIC and near-zero FCF conversion.

name: Glacier Bancorp, Inc.
reason: Serial-acquirer community bank: shares +4.7%/yr over 10y while adjusted EPS grew only 2.6%/yr and fell to 1.99 from 2.86 (2021), so growth has come from acquisitions not the core franchise.

name: Franklin Templeton, Inc.
reason: Active asset manager in structural outflows (Western Asset), adjusted EPS -3.9%/yr over 10y with EBIT margin down from 38.5% to 12.8%, acquisition-driven (acq/FCF 0.58) and net debt/EBITDA 5.9x; market-driven and not special.

name: Regal Rexnord Corporation
reason: Growth from levered acquisitions (Rexnord PMC, Altra; acq/FCF 1.26, shares +4%/yr) with net debt/EBITDA 3.7x in a cyclical industrial, 4.4% avg ROIC and adjusted EPS 125% above GAAP; fails the core-growth and balance-sheet tests.

name: Korn Ferry
reason: Net-cash executive search and talent consulting leader, but earnings follow the hiring cycle (EPS 6.23 in FY21 vs 4.28 in FY23) and AI disintermediation of RPO, professional search and assessment is a credible 5-year threat, so the long-run path is hard to forecast.
